description: Erection of outbuilding at rear of property.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (659/OS1, 659/OS2, 659/01, 659/02, 659/03, 659/04, 659/05, 659/06, 659/07, 659/08, Design & Heritage Impact Statement , Tree Survey, CTC TCP 200009-01 received 5 July 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building except where specified in the hereby approved drawings.

Condition : 4 - The detached single storey outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house at the 'Site Address' described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose (for example, it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, living room, bathroom or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes).

Condition : 5 - The root protection areas of all the trees shown to be retained in the tree study material submitted with the application shall be protected for the duration of any ground clearance, preparatory and construction work by stout exclusion fencing (except where this is not practicable owing to the requirement to construct the building) and no building materials, plant, equipment and associated substances shall be stored or spilled, nor any fires lit within the root protection area.  Excavations shall be carried out by hand, other than for the sinking of piles and tree roots shall be severed only where this is essential for the construction.  The foundations shall be constructed as shown in the approved section drawings
